mapper.select: SELECT exercise_id, parts_id, name, created_at, updated_at FROM exercises WHERE updated_at > #{updatedAt} ORDER BY exercise_id, parts_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO my_exercises(exercise_id, user_id, parts_id, name, created_at, updated_at) VALUES(#{exerciseId}, #{userId}, #{partsId}, #{name}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}) ON CONFLICT (exercise_id, user_id) DO UPDATE SET parts_id=EXCLUDED.parts_id, name=EXCLUDED.name, updated_at=EXCLUDED.updated_at
